Global Markets React to Geopolitical Tensions and Economic Uncertainty

Global financial markets experienced fluctuations due to lingering geopolitical tensions, particularly concerning the Middle East, and evolving economic forecasts. The Indian rupee weakened against the dollar amid these uncertainties. Oil prices saw a decline as demand forecasts were cut, despite ongoing supply risks linked to the US-Iran situation. In Japan, efforts to support the yen faced challenges, with analysts suggesting significant reserves remain for further intervention. The UK economy's growth prospects were projected to be low if Middle East disruptions continue. Meanwhile, gold prices rose, influenced by reduced expectations for Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
